insights.title: True Entry Point: $329K
insights.body: Lombardo's Pembrooke South (New Haven) at $328,990 is the verified lowest new construction price in the market. Legacy Village Villas (Shelby Twp) at $339,990 is close behind. Pulte Clinton Twp from $399,990. This shows a real affordable-tier competition emerging in northern Macomb.

insights.title: Stoney Creek Crossing is the Oakland Benchmark
insights.body: Lombardo's Stoney Creek Crossing (Oakland Twp, 25957 Enclave Dr) from $816,990 with Rochester Schools is the flagship 2025–2026 Oakland County community. The Huntington plan starts at $1,031,990. This sets the competitive benchmark for high-end Oakland County new construction.

insights.title: MJC Reaching $1M+ in Washington Twp
insights.body: MJC White Oaks (Washington Twp) runs $761,900–$1,088,790 and Oakland Hunt (Oakland Twp) reaches $947,900. MJC is no longer just a mid-market builder — they're competing directly with Toll Brothers at the luxury tier.

insights.title: Shelby Township: Most Competitive ZIP
insights.body: Shelby Township has the most builder overlap of any single municipality: Pulte, Lombardo (3 communities), MJC, Vitale, Acadia, Cherry Creek, DM Homes, and Lassale all active or planned within Shelby Township. The 25 Mile & Schoenherr corridor is ground zero.

insights.title: Toll Brothers: 9 Communities Across SE Michigan
insights.body: Toll Brothers has significantly more reach than previously documented — 9 total communities in the Detroit metro: 2 Oakland County (Reserve WB + Crystal Lake), 1 coming Oakland (Altair Ridge), plus 6 in Wayne/Washtenaw counties. Wayne and Washtenaw are direct competition for luxury buyers who might consider Oakland.

insights.title: Ranch/Low-Maintenance Dominates
insights.body: The biggest product trend: ranch condos & low-maintenance attached. Pulte Corners at Cherry Glen (100 ranch units $497K), Villas at Forest Glen (45 units $425K), Lombardo Windemere Farms II ($330K), Legacy Village Villas ($340K), Orchard Crossing Villas ($470K). Multiple builders chasing the same buyer.

insights.title: Lombardo's True Reach is 27 Communities
insights.body: Lombardo is far larger than initially shown — 27 Michigan communities from $329K (New Haven) to $1.03M (Stoney Creek Crossing Huntington plan). They span Macomb, Oakland, Wayne, Washtenaw, Livingston, and Lapeer counties. The largest single-builder presence in SE Michigan.

insights.title: Coming Soon Pipeline
insights.body: Altair Ridge (Toll Brothers, Orion Twp): summer 2026, mid-$400Ks. Olejnik Acres (M/I Homes, Macomb Twp): Card Rd, coming soon. Highland Hills (Vitale, Bruce Twp): 25 lots, reservations open. Bradbury South (MJC, Washington Twp): pricing TBD. Broadmoor (Lombardo, Howell): next phase 2027.
